Each expert has areas where they have and have not worked on deer populations in the UK

We need to ask them for these areas

```{r}
#Read in current deer risk maps

bng <- "EPSG:27700"

small_deer_risk <- terra::rast("C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer/output/Final_risk_maps/small_deer_risk_raster_EW.tif")
crs(small_deer_risk) <- bng

large_deer_risk <- raster()
```

```{r}
#Make a 5km2 bounding box to crop the risk maps

library(terra)

buffer_distance <- 2500  # Distance in meters (half of 5 km² side)

create_bbox <- function(lat, lon, buffer_distance) {
  # Calculate the min and max coordinates for the extent
  xmin <- lon - buffer_distance / 111320  # Approx. meters to degrees longitude
  xmax <- lon + buffer_distance / 111320
  ymin <- lat - buffer_distance / 111320  # Approx. meters to degrees latitude
  ymax <- lat + buffer_distance / 111320
  
  # Create and return a SpatExtent object
  ext(xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)
}

```

```{r}
#Function to save rasters ####

save_rasters <- function(raster_list, output_folder, prefix = "", suffix = "", overwrite = TRUE) {
  # Ensure the output folder exists
  if (!dir.exists(output_folder)) {
    dir.create(output_folder, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Save each raster in the list to the output folder
  for (raster_name in names(raster_list)) {
    # Construct the file name with prefix and suffix
    file_name <- paste0(prefix, raster_name, suffix, ".tif")
    file_path <- file.path(output_folder, file_name)
    
    # Write the raster to disk
    writeRaster(raster_list[[raster_name]], file_path, format = "GTiff", overwrite = overwrite)
  }
}

```

```{r}
# Tom Logan familiar areas
tom_coords <- data.frame(
  lat = c(54.51762549311087, 53.87333542160211, 53.63131346257901, 53.86794131276967, 54.54878727845816, 54.33134092965284),
  lon = c(-3.148665288562973, -1.5788324024401497, -0.8981366765395856, -1.5869010247593411, -3.102771158037833, -0.6947728035262719),
  sites = c("Borrowdale", "Gair wood", "Thorne moors", "Adel Dam", "Above Raven Crag", "Hole of Horcum")
)

# Create bounding boxes for Tom's sites
buffer_distance <- 2500  # Buffer distance in meters
tom_bboxes <- lapply(1:nrow(tom_coords), function(i) {
  create_bbox(tom_coords$lat[i], tom_coords$lon[i], buffer_distance)
})

tom_bboxes <- lapply(st_as_sf(tom_bboxes))

# Reproject each bounding box in tom_bboxes
tom_bboxes <- lapply(tom_bboxes, function(bbox) {
  project(bbox, crs(small_deer_risk))  # Reproject to raster CRS
})

# Small deer risk rasters (assuming small_deer_risk is loaded and in the correct CRS)
borrowdale_small_risk_map <- crop(small_deer_risk, tom_bboxes[[1]])
gairwood_small_risk_map <- crop(small_deer_risk, tom_bboxes[[2]])
thornemoors_small_risk_map <- crop(small_deer_risk, tom_bboxes[[3]])
adeldam_small_risk_map <- crop(small_deer_risk, tom_bboxes[[4]])
ravencrag_small_risk_map <- crop(small_deer_risk, tom_bboxes[[5]])
holeofhorcum_small_risk_map <- crop(small_deer_risk, tom_bboxes[[6]])

# List of cropped small risk maps
small_risk_maps_tom <- list(
  Borrowdale = borrowdale_small_risk_map,
  GairWood = gairwood_small_risk_map,
  ThorneMoors = thornemoors_small_risk_map,
  AdelDam = adeldam_small_risk_map,
  RavenCrag = ravencrag_small_risk_map,
  HoleOfHorcum = holeofhorcum_small_risk_map
)

# Save rasters
save_rasters(
  raster_list = small_risk_maps_tom,
  output_folder = "./output/Expert_maps/Logan_T",
  prefix = "current_small_risk_",  # Optional prefix
  suffix = "_2023"                # Optional suffix
)
```
